Feat Catalogue

Class-granted choices are shown in the class section. Purchased feats use Mission Points; any feat prerequisites are displayed with the feat.

Homebrew Feats

3. Equipment

Mission Preparation and Base Kit

Prep rating belongs to a mission and can change from one mission to the next. At Prep-1 or higher, characters receive the base kit; Prep-2 and above also add shared team supplies.

Armor and Loadout

Armor sets AC and the extra bulk you can carry. Wearing armor without proficiency imposes the rulebook penalties; heavy armor also reduces speed by 2m, and insufficient Strength can reduce it to 1m.

Additional Gear

Items added here count against the armor’s extra loadout bulk. Standard base-kit items do not. Mission reward items are listed automatically.

Attacks and Weaponry

Select each attack’s proficiency type; the creator adds the proficiency bonus only when the character has that proficiency. Common Weapons or Explosives proficiency also covers grenades.

An unarmed strike is always included on your sheet. It automatically becomes Martial Arts when you have that proficiency. It uses no equipment or bulk.

4. Mission Tracker

Log completed and custom missions, MP earned, and rewards. Completed mission MP is added to the character’s earned total. Feat or perk rewards and equipment are recorded without charging MP.

No missions logged yet.

Official Missions

Expand a mission, tick the objectives achieved and choose its rewards, then mark it finished. MP and selected rewards apply automatically. Unticking suspends them while keeping your choices. Reward details reveal mission outcomes: open them after play or with your GM. Custom missions remain in the log below.

Mission Log

5. Rosters

Save complete character records into named groups. Choose a folder once to keep a shared Stargate Rosters.json file there; use Import and Export when folder access is unavailable.

Roster JSON File

The JSON contains the character’s personal details, level and MP, selected traits and feats, equipment, mission log, and any headshot or emblem image.

Rosters are stored in this browser until you choose a folder or export a JSON file.
